versions.content: Available communication means Type: valid Description: The ECU Resource template shall provide dedicated means to describe communication hardware. Rationale: The communication of the ECU is essential and shall be described in a coordinated way together with the System Description and the ECU Configuration. Use Case: • Describe the network ports used for the System Description and the communication design between ECUs. • Describe network ports which are not part of the System Description (local network ports to access intelligent sensors/actuators). Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
